articles.headline: Houston muscles past Kansas to cap 3-day run, stamps claim to No. 1 ranking
articles.description: Houston made a clear statement it belongs atop the rankings, capping its run through the Players Era 8 win a 92-83 win over No. 11 Kansas on Thursday night.

articles.headline: Mercy Miller powers No. 8 Houston past No. 11 Kansas for Players Era 8 title
articles.description: — Mercy Miller scored 21 points and No. 8 Houston held off a late charge by No. 11 Kansas to win the Players Era 8 tournament championship 92-83 on Thursday night.
